official_definition: Flash - Consecutive Dominance (When Attacks) By discarding three of this Spirit's Red pre-advent cards, when this turn ends, (Your Turn) occurs one more time.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Consecutive Dominance] or [Consecutive Dominance: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Consecutive Dominance]", "give [Consecutive Dominance]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
